headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 21 points and 17 rebounds and the Milwaukee Bucks snapped a three-game losing streak, holding off the Atlanta Hawks 112-110 on Monday after squandering a 23-point lead in the second half.
headlines.shortLinkText: Antetokounmpo and the Bucks hold off Atlanta 112-110 to snap a three-game skid

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 30 points, Chet Holmgren added 28 and the Oklahoma City Thunder rolled to a 136-104 victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: NBA-leading Thunder crush Cavaliers 136-104 behind Gilgeous-Alexander's 30 points

headlines.description: — James Harden scored 36 points, and when he finally missed a couple big free throws in the final seconds, the ball came right back to him as the Los Angeles Clippers edged the Washington Wizards 110-106 on Monday for their sixth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harden scores 36 as the Clippers hold off the Wizards for their 6th straight win

events.name: Dallas Mavericks at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Max Christie scored a season-high 26 points, Cooper Flagg had 18 in his first pro game at Madison Square Garden and the Dallas Mavericks rolled to a 114-97 victory Monday over the New York Knicks, who were booed frequently in the first half while...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Flagg returns to help Mavericks blow out Knicks as boos rain down at Madison Square Garden

events.name: Utah Jazz at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had a season-high seven 3-pointers and finished with 33 points and 10 rebounds hours after being named an All-Star starter for the first time as the San Antonio Spurs beat the Utah Jazz 123-110 on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama scores 33 points in 123-110 win over Jazz after being named All-Star starter

headlines.shortLinkText: Tyrese Maxey celebrates 1st All-Star game starting nod with 29 points in 76ers' win over Pacers

headlines.description: — Dillon Brooks scored 27 points, Devin Booker had 23 and the Phoenix Suns beat the Brooklyn Nets 126-117 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brooks and Booker power Suns to a 126-117 win over the struggling Nets

headlines.description: — Tobias Harris scored 25 points and Jaylen Brown missed a jumper just before the buzzer, allowing the Detroit Pistons to hold on for a 104-103 win over the Boston Celtics on Monday night in a matchup of teams with the best records in the Eastern...
headlines.shortLinkText: Harris scores 25, Brown misses potential game-winner and Pistons hold off Celtics for 104-103 win

events.name: Miami Heat at Golden State Warriors

headlines.shortLinkText: Warriors star Jimmy Butler goes down with right knee injury in win over Heat
